items.discovered_by: TEST-RUNNER Step 05 (independent 5x verification of the ISS-0148 fix)
items.note: RESOLVED. Root cause was NOT the 23505 (that is TC-TNT-02-05's deliberate duplicate-insert assertion, constant at 1/run on passing runs) and NOT the ISS-0148 sweep (pg_locks sampling during hangs showed zero ungranted locks). Commit db362fd (GH-402) deleted all three pg_advisory_lock acquires from tests/integration/helpers.zig while leaving the matching pg_advisory_unlock in place, so concurrent test binaries ran their migration check-and-apply unguarded. Restored all three acquires with the ISS-0107 lock_timeout bracket. Post-fix: 5/5 exit 0 (plus 6 more consecutive), 34/34 tests passed, 42P01 total 0.
